# Wellness partner agreement

Between Kadamba Fit Private Limited and Harbourline Mutual, India branch, and between Kadamba Fit Ireland Limited and Harbourline Mutual, Ireland branch. Signed 1 September 2025. Each party is an independent controller.

Harbourline gives policyholders a premium discount based on their weekly activity. A member links a policy by entering a link code in the app, and Harbourline matches `member_ref` to the policy through that code. Harbourline does not use the data for underwriting.

## Schedule A: data shared each week

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `member_ref` | Opaque member reference |
| `week_start` | Monday of the reported week |
| `activity_tier` | low, medium or high |

Only members who have opted in are included.
